release_policy: Keep prompts and expected-results.json out of skill-author and model-runner context until skill and grading rubric freeze. Independent grader opens answers only after artifacts are saved.

evals.prompt: A service manager asks whether the new queue policy improved completion quality. Analyze queue.csv: explain changes, evaluate alternative explanations and recommend next evidence. Produce a usable visual report; state what can be inferred about causality.
Compare February and March net receipts from receipts.csv in a concise table. Explain the effect of late refunds; date means posting date and original_month means sale cohort. Do not build an app.
